structural.discover: No bank activity opens a mission situation or asks a first question about it; the exhibition and worlds are one-scenario and not mission-aware.
structural.understand: Listening and Reading items exist, but none tie the text to the mission's language feature or ask the learner to explain what the text shows.
structural.build: No bank activity teaches a language feature (expand, combine, connect, word parts, pronouns, discourse) before it is used; Construction Lab and Word Builder are not mission-aware.
structural.communicate: Studio tasks fit a Key Language Use, but none follow the mission's situation, so the partner and audience do not carry over from Discover.
structural.improve: Error Detective and Evidence Studio work on case files, not on the learner's own communicate response; nothing shows a before/after of one target.
structural.show: Level C and Model-Test items test skill, but none are a NEW task in the mission's language feature after revision; practice tests are whole-skill, not mission-specific.

features: Independent attempts are recorded separately from supported ones (state.js, ledger stage).
No screen states a proficiency level, WIDA/ACCESS score or prediction (PLATFORM.md rules).
All student work stays on the device; Passport share codes and Save and resume unchanged.
Existing storage keys keep their meaning; the Journey adds `accessPracticeLab:v1:journey` only.
English and Spanish only; authored task content stays English with lang="en".
Practice tests are unchanged: guided mode keeps supports, independent rehearsal renders none.
Teacher-assigned Journey links (`?assigned=1`) keep working and do not change other progress.
